items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Avoid the broken unselected terminal-browser action path**

When a project-map pane is open, this unselected `terminal-browser action` call can drive a newly launched invisible Chrome instead of the visible terminal pane, so the hook exits successfully without refreshing the map and may leave extra browser processes. The [upstream bug report](https://github.com/zenbu-labs/terminal-browser/issues/60) reproduces this exact command form, and the [current implementation](https://github.com/zenbu-labs/terminal-browser/blob/main/cli/src/action.ts#L255-L268) still omits the selected browser's `--cdp` value from the final invocation. The test only stubs `terminal-browser` and verifies argv, so it does not close the threat-table row claiming that the active pane reloads; use a reliably targeted invocation and exercise it against the real CLI.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L77-L78](https://github.com/mryfmo/dotfiles/blob/2c444b08eb1693c94bedef3568efeede30510b19/AGENTS.md#L77-L78)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
